notes.subject: fix(node-host): stop failed MCP timer reconnects crashing the CLI
notes.summary: Failed scheduled MCP server reconnects are now logged instead of crashing the CLI with an unhandled rejection.

notes.subject: fix(node-host): skip unchanged shared Keychain writes
notes.summary: Shared Keychain writes are skipped when the value is unchanged, so VS Code, CLI and Desktop stop re-prompting for Keychain access after another surface rewrites the item.

notes.subject: feat(credentials): share macOS Keychain items through a signed AgentLink Credentials helper
notes.summary: Signed macOS builds route shared Keychain access through an AgentLink Credentials helper so one Always Allow covers VS Code, CLI and Desktop; the CLI runtime is renamed to AgentLink CLI and the node-host SDK exports helper configuration functions.

notes.subject: fix(credentials): serialize macOS helper prompts
notes.summary: Credentials helper requests are queued across consumers and processes so macOS does not show a stack of Keychain prompts, and the queue is held until a timed-out helper exits.

notes.subject: fix(credentials): avoid a second provider Keychain prompt
notes.summary: OpenAI-compatible provider migration state is read from a private local file so startup needs only one Keychain prompt, with deletion tombstones preventing legacy keys from being resurrected.

notes.subject: fix(credentials): share standalone MCP Keychain vault
notes.summary: The CLI and Desktop now share one standalone MCP OAuth Keychain vault, lazily importing their older items and keeping them as compatibility replicas, and node-host exports a new createStandaloneMcpCredentialRepository.

notes.subject: fix(core): forward standalone model request controls
notes.summary: The core agent engine now forwards all standalone run options (model request controls) to turn preparation instead of only a selected few.

notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): pin streaming status row on desktop like VS Code
notes.summary: The streaming status bar is now pinned on Desktop and browser gateway during long turns, matching VS Code, so it no longer scrolls out of view.
